Brute Force Summary

Brute Force is a futuristic, high-octane slot from Nolimit City that leans into the studio's "un-chill" philosophy with a sci-fi spin. Set in a neon-drenched, dystopian world of high-tech warfare, this game moves away from gritty realism into the realm of hyper-volatile action. At Playin.com, you can engage with this high-tech battlefield using Playin coins.

The core of the gameplay is centered around the xNudge mechanic, which is the primary driver of its 40,000x max win potential. In Brute Force, xNudge Wilds can land on the central reels and will always nudge to become fully visible. Every step the wild takes increases a win multiplier, and if multiple xNudge Wilds are part of a win, their multipliers are added together for massive payouts. To complement this, the xWays mechanic frequently triggers, expanding the number of ways to win and creating the density needed for the multipliers to truly take effect.

For technical players, the allure of Brute Force lies in its tiered bonus rounds: Brute Spins and Super Brute Spins. In these modes, the xNudge Wilds become even more potent, often becoming sticky or carrying over multipliers between spins. Understanding these triggers is essential, as the game’s extreme variance means the biggest hits are heavily concentrated in these features. By testing the demo on our platform, you can get a feel for the hit frequency and how the xMechanics interact before stepping into a more competitive environment.

If you are looking to test your tactical skills against the community, Brute Force is a regular highlight in our free tournament section. You can compete for real prizes while climbing the Net Balance leaderboard using virtual currency. The game’s sharp, futuristic graphics and fast-paced animations are fully optimized for mobile devices, ensuring the "brute force" of the gameplay remains intact on any screen size.

If the high-tech intensity of this title appeals to you, you may also find interest in the mechanical complexity of Tanked or the dark narrative depth of San Quentin 2: Death Row. Whether you are analyzing the multiplier growth or chasing a max win, Playin.com provides the ultimate free-to-play destination for the Nolimit City portfolio.

Game Features

xNudge® Wilds

There are 3 types of xNudge® Wilds which land as a stacked symbol and always nudge to be fully visible. A random multiplier value updates at the bottom of xNudge® Wild when it’s fully visible and adds to the xNudge® Wild multiplier value, respectively. xNudge® Wilds have different nudge multiplier value: - Joshua xNudge® Wild - Each nudge increases the win multiplier value by +1 and the maximum multiplier value can be awarded is 8x. - Jason xNudge® Wild - Each nudge increases the win multiplier value by +2 and the maximum multiplier value can be awarded is 21x. - Hyper xNudge® Wild - Each nudge increases the win multiplier value by +5 and the maximum multiplier value can be awarded is 51x.

xNudge® Meter

The xNudge® Meter summarizes the overall xNudge® multiplier values on the winning symbols.

Brute Spins

Landing 3 Scatter symbols will activate 10 Brute Spins.

Super Brute Spins

Landing 4 Scatter symbols will activate 10 Super Brute Spins. In addition to Brute Spins, Nudge Wilds may become sticky and remain persistent throughout Super Brute Spins.

xBet™ (Nolimit Booster)

At a cost of 4.7 times the base bet, the player is guaranteed a Scatter symbol on reel 2. 10 times more likely to hit Freespins.

1 Guaranteed xNudge® Wild (Nolimit Booster)

At the cost of 60 times the base bet, the player is guaranteed minimum of 1 xNudge® Wild.

2 Guaranteed xNudge® Wilds (Nolimit Booster)

At the cost of 333 times the base bet, the player is guaranteed minimum of 2 xNudge® Wilds.

4 Guaranteed xNudge® Wilds (Nolimit Booster)

At the cost of 4,000 times the base bet, the player is guaranteed minimum of 4 xNudge® Wilds.

Nolimit Bonus Buy

Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 100 to 800 times the base bet.

The Nolimit Bonus feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Nolimit Booster

Buy a specific game feature in the Nolimit Bonus tool. The total cost for the activated feature will be charged from your balance for each spin.

The Nolimit Booster feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Action Spins

Get your adrenaline flowing and play your regular bonus rounds in HYPER MODE! ‘Action Spins’ is a new optional feature that ushers in an innovative way to play a high volume of rounds of the Base Game or Multiple Bonus rounds in a rapid and exhilarating way!

The Action Spins feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Game xMechanics

xBet®

At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

xNudge®

xNudge®: A simple yet effective feature that turns any game into a massive potential bearing title! xNudge works alongside wild reels, wherein landing a wild in view has the potential to increase the multiplier attached, as the wild nudges to fill the entire reel. If the wild is not centred in the reel, it will either nudge up or down, incrementing its multiplier by 1 for each nudge.
